## Sable Offshore Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Results


11/09/2026


Download (opens in new window)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sable Offshore Corp. (“Sable,” or the “Company”) (NYSE: SOC) today announced its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


- Achieved $154.4 million in total revenue in the third quarter of 2026, representing a 13% increase quarter over quarter.
- Ended the quarter with $38.0 million of cash and cash equivalents.
- Ended the quarter with 207,980,283 shares of Common Stock outstanding after selling 16,110,711 shares of Common Stock in our at-the-market (“ATM”) equity program for an average price of approximately $4.75 per share during the quarter.


**Third Quarter 2026 Operational Results**


- Reported average daily net sales volumes of approximately 27 thousand net barrels of oil per day, representing a 29% increase quarter over quarter.
- Produced at an average rate of 795 gross barrels of oil per day, per well, throughout the quarter from an average of 37 wells per day.
- Perforation Addition (“Perf Add”) operations continued to see positive well results at the upper end of management expectations with average increased production rates of over 700 barrels of oil per day per well.
- Average reservoir pressure throughout the Upper Siliceous, Massive Chert, and Lower Calcareous zones of the Monterey formation at the SYU remained stable in the third quarter.
- Sable observed little to no production decline from producing wells in the quarter.


**Platform Hondo Update**


- Sable has submitted its final paperwork to the Marine Minerals Administration (“MMA”) reflecting all platform upgrades and is currently testing its new state of the art platform control system.
- Physical MMA inspections on Platform Hondo and initial production are scheduled for November.
- All producing wells are scheduled to be online and flowing to sales in December 2026 at a forecasted rate of approximately 10,000 gross barrels of oil per day.


**Midstream and Brent Crude Oil Marketing Update**


- Crude oil sales were halted by our sole downstream crude purchaser in early October 2026 due to maintenance and upgrades to storage tanks at their refinery.
- Sable has diversified and improved its marketing optionality by beginning to sell crude oil to three additional Los Angeles-area refineries in early November 2026. Sable expects all four major Los Angeles-area refineries to increase their purchases of SYU crude over time.
- Sable is evaluating all options to resolve near-term working capital constraints caused by the downstream purchaser disruption, including selling its crude oil currently held in inventory via a bulk sale agreement.
- The addition of Platform Hondo’s lighter and sweeter crude is anticipated to improve overall sulfur content of SYU crude oil production field-wide.


**Financial Updates**


- No ATM equity sales have occurred in Q4 2026 to date. The most recent sale of shares under our ATM occurred on September 17, 2026.


**About Sable**


Sable Offshore Corp. is an independent oil and gas company, headquartered in Houston, Texas, focused on responsibly developing the Santa Ynez Unit in federal waters offshore California. The Sable team has extensive experience safely operating in California.
